title: Do You Love Me
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Do You Love Me | New Beginnings, Agape Love, Restored Purpose, and Assurance - John v21:15-17

Jesus meets us after failure with grace, not rejection. In John v21, Peter comes face to face with the risen Lord after denying Him, and the question that matters most still comes to us: _Do you love Me more than these?_ Christ does not leave His children in shame. He restores, renews, and calls us forward again.

Peter cannot boast in his own strength anymore, but he can come honestly to Jesus. That is where healing begins. The Lord brings Peter from brokenness to purpose, and He still gives new beginnings to those who have fallen, doubted, or grown weary. His mercies are new every morning, and real joy is found not in comfort, success, or possessions, but in loving Jesus above all.

Agape love becomes the mark of a surrendered life. When we love Christ first, we can serve others, endure hardship, and walk with deeper assurance. This life is brief, eternity is real, and today is the day to follow Him wholeheartedly.
